question: What motive justifies the effort to rescue humans immersed in the mire of sin?
premises: Humans can be immersed in the mire of sin.
Such immersion constitutes a degraded condition.
A desire to lift them up motivates compassionate action.
inference: Compassionate intervention toward sinful humans is justified by the intention to rescue them.
plain_english: Out of a desire to lift up men who are immersed in the mire of sin.
